rule: The generator must use the official 2026-27 15E blueprint for allocation. The observed 47-question structure is the implementation baseline from the supplied 15E paper and must be validated against the current blueprint before publication.

slot_rules.selection: one item from each required language format
four analogy items with varied relationship types
voice, question formation and specified word-use formats
balanced textbook coverage; avoid over-repeating one chapter
mix First Flight and Footprints according to blueprint
reported speech, sentence transformation and degrees of comparison
one prescribed poem/stanza with an OR alternative where required
long-answer literature questions with OR alternatives where prescribed
new passage; test retrieval, inference and vocabulary

selection_constraints: Never select content outside the 15E NCERT prescribed scope.
Never mix 14E or 31E question formats/content into a 15E paper without explicit evidence that the same format is required for 15E.
Prefer unseen combinations of already-learned content over repeated wording.
Keep difficulty balanced across easy, medium and challenging items.
Do not duplicate the same question in a single paper.
Validate marks before publishing: total must equal 100.
Validate numbering before publishing: exactly 47 numbered questions.
Treat OR alternatives as alternatives, not additional scored questions.
